request.objective: Start at https://www.qatarairways.com/. Find the weight of baggage allowance for economy class on Qatar Airways.

response.result:
Qatar Airways’ Economy baggage allowance depends on the route and fare type:

- **Checked baggage on flights to or from Africa or the Americas:** Economy Lite allows **1 piece up to 23 kg (50 lb)**. Economy Classic, Convenience and Comfort allow **2 pieces, up to 23 kg (50 lb) each**.
- **Checked baggage on other destinations:** Lite **20 kg (44 lb)**, Classic **25 kg (55 lb)**, Convenience **30 kg (66 lb)** and Comfort **35 kg (77 lb)**.
- **Carry-on:** **1 piece up to 7 kg (15 lb)**. On flights to or from Brazil, Economy passengers may carry **1 piece up to 10 kg (22 lb)**.

Exceptions apply on some routes; the allowance for a particular trip can be checked in the booking or under Manage booking.
